title: Be an accredited transport booking service
what: Be accredited before operating a transport booking service (taxi or rideshare booking).

sources.title: Road Transport (Public Passenger Services) Act 2001 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 32(1) (current republication (R39, from 5 January 2026; Road Transport (Public Passenger Services) Act 2001 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if the person— (a) operates a transport booking service; and (b) is not an accredited transport booking service.
